structured_output.summary: The change implements all six spec steps in order, each with its comment. It uses shared helpers from `support::disposable_stack` (`require_async_disposable_stack`, `async_disposable_stack`, `add_disposable_resource`) and `ops::is_callable`. Every fallible call propagates with `?`. The ReferenceError for a disposed stack is checked before the TypeError for a non-callable argument, as the spec orders them. The result is `Ok(Value::Undefined)`. There are no special cases and no swallowed errors. The gate report shows 22 of 22 target tests passing with no regressions, which fits the size of the change. I did not open the helper modules, so I am assuming `add_disposable_resource` appends to the `DisposableResourceStack` as AddDisposableResource requires.
